title: docs(spec): metadata.endpoints.item names the package-qualified by-name read it already gates
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XLh5FYHMd4Auwhkc7GbR3DV)_

Fixes #33085

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`RestServerConfig.metadata.endpoints.item` 的 describe 补上它已经在关的第 14 条路由 `GET /meta/:type/:ns/:name`(ADR-0150 D5 的按包限定读取);liveness 台账同一行的说明把「十三条」改成「十四条」;参考文档那一行重新生成。
- 为什么改:这个开关的 describe 承诺列出关掉它会移除的每一条路由,`@objectstack/rest` 的挂载表测试实测是 14 条,文案只列了 13 条,运维读文档会以为限定读取不受它控制。
- 风险与回滚:只改说明文字,不动路由、默认值或可接受的值;spec patch changeset。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/api/rest-server.zod.ts` 里 `item` 的 describe;其次 `packages/spec/liveness/metadata_endpoints.json` 的 `endpoints.item` 行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts`,预期 24/24 通过,其中 `metadata.endpoints.item` 行列出的 14 条与新 describe 一一对应。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/api/rest-server.zod.ts`: the `metadata.endpoints.item` `describe()` now names the package-qualified by-name read `GET /meta/:type/:ns/:name` (ADR-0150 D5), which answers through the item read's own handler. The string now names all fourteen routes the mount-table pin lists for this switch: `GET`/`PUT`/`DELETE /meta/:type/:name`, `/references`, `/layers`, the six history routes, the qualified read, the book tree and the app metadata bundle.
- `packages/spec/liveness/metadata_endpoints.json`: the `endpoints.item` row note said "thirteen mounts since #27627"; it now says fourteen and names both additions (#27627's bundle, ADR-0150 D5's qualified read). Folded under the bounded same-class fix; the seat amended the claim's file surface (comment 6880069048).
- `content/docs/references/api/rest-server.mdx`: the generated row, regenerated by `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix` (it proved only `check:docs` stale).
- `.changeset/33085-item-describe-qualified-read.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch. The describe ships in `dist`, and `liveness/` is in spec `files[]`.

## Why

The JSDoc above `endpoints` says each switch's `describe()` enumerates every mount it takes. The pin `packages/rest/src/rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts` on `origin/main` `fd7b378c` lists fourteen routes under `metadata.endpoints.item`, and the describe listed thirteen. No other route in that row moved since the card was filed (`/references` and `/layers` were already named). The describe follows the pin; `packages/rest/**` is untouched.

## Tests

- No behaviour changes, so no test is added and nothing is ablated.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/api/rest-server`: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 53 passed (53).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts` (read-only, as the measurement): Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 24 passed (24).

## Acceptance notes

The same count drift sits in files outside this card's surface, so they are listed here and in the report for the seat to file:

- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` (the `registerPerItemRoute` docblock in `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`) says the per-item face is "thirteen mounts" and leaves out the qualified read.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` (the `endpoints` member docblock of the normalized config) lists `maintenance` as `/diagnostics`, `/_drafts`, `POST /_migrate-stored` and leaves out `POST /_migrate-record-currency-codes`, which the pin lists as the fourth.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json` (`api-backend.rest-metadata-config-contract`) says `item` takes thirteen mounts in three places and does not name the qualified read.

## Verification

On `cc5adeb4`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 101 commands. 100 ran with exit 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package's `dist`, and only the spec, lint, objectql and client closures were built), so it is NOT MEASURED here and left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: "101 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 100 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED". `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` exit 0.
